about:
Hostile set for ensembles and comparison records (docs/ensemble-spec.md
section 7), written BEFORE any ensemble code. Run from the repository root:

cases.name: benzene, K = 10
cases.worst: ten copies averaged as if independent
cases.why: a rigid molecule has one conformer

cases.name: cyclohexane
cases.why: the chair, and a twist-boat only if distinct

cases.name: 18-crown-6 (macrocycle)
cases.worst: every member called folded because the ring opens a hole
cases.why: ring genus is a diagnostic, not the folded rule

cases.name: C18 acetate, K = 10
cases.worst: folded members averaged in without a flag
cases.why: the measured site spread is 5.1 with folded members, 2.69 without

cases.name: E4 with the folded members' surfaces failing integrity
cases.worst: a converged-looking ensemble of only extended members
cases.why: the chi = 2 check once excluded exactly the folded C18 members (F9)

cases.name: n-butane: gauche+ and gauche- (mirror-related, achiral molecule)
cases.why: anti and one gauche; the mirror gauche is the same conformer for an achiral molecule

cases.name: supplied: 20 conformers ('poses') of one ligand
cases.worst: refused, or computed as pose 1 only
cases.why: a docking run is a legitimate ensemble

cases.name: supplied: a ligand mixed with its tautomer
cases.why: one ensemble, one molecule

cases.name: supplied: one record's atom order permuted
cases.worst: site rows from the wrong atoms
cases.why: reorder by verified mapping, or refuse; never trust file order across records

cases.name: members under two different bases
cases.why: every member shares one analysis_key

cases.name: --weight dft, one member 5 kcal/mol below the rest
cases.worst: a weighted mean presented as an ensemble of K
cases.why: Kish n makes dominance visible

cases.name: MMFF energies offered as weights
cases.worst: a near-single-member average from force-field energies
cases.why: MMFF orders members, never weights them

cases.name: threonine with no stereo, generated
cases.why: generated ensembles need stereo fully specified

cases.name: octadecyl acetate with a single g+g- kink
cases.worst: an ordinary kink counted as folding
cases.why: an extended chain with one ordinary kink; whether the spec's contact rule (>= 5 bonds, Bondi + 0.5 A) passes it is what this case tests

cases.name: supplied: one centre inverted in one member
cases.why: members must share one 3D stereo completion

cases.name: --weight dft on single points of MMFF geometries
cases.why: weighting needs optimised members

cases.name: supplied: a constitutional isomer mixed in
cases.worst: a record whose identity and members disagree
cases.why: one InChIKey per ensemble, checked on every member

cases.name: trans-cyclooctenol from SMILES, generated
cases.worst: members of both ring helicities averaged as one stereoisomer
cases.why: review 6 S1: an E bond in a ring of 8 or fewer fixes the bond, not the ring's planar chirality, and no SMILES can fix it

cases.name: generated from a 3D allene file that fixes the axis
cases.why: review 6 S1: re-embedding from the graph drops the axis the file fixed

cases.name: supplied: trans-cyclooctenol, both ring helicities
cases.why: review 6 S1: verify_computed and the 3D stereo check see the centre, not the helicity

cases.name: supplied: an allene, both axes, one centre
cases.why: review 6 S1: RDKit assigns no allene axis from 3D

cases.name: supplied: ethyl cation, radical and anion on one skeleton
cases.why: review 6 S2: same nuclei, different electron count; only record 1 was gated

cases.name: E22 with the radical first
cases.worst: an outcome that depends on record order
cases.why: review 6 S2

cases.name: supplied: atom maps that disagree between records
cases.worst: a site keyed by map 1 pointing at different atoms in different members
cases.why: review 6 S2: maps are the user's names for atoms; members must agree

cases.name: supplied: record 2 of 3 cannot be read
cases.worst: a two-member ensemble with the lost record never named
cases.why: review 6 S6: unreadable records were dropped and the rest renumbered

cases.name: A compared with itself
cases.why: no difference is no difference

cases.name: A and B at different bases
cases.why: analysis_key fields must match

cases.name: SMARTS matching two non-equivalent atoms in B
cases.why: butane-1,3-diol has two different OH groups

cases.name: a difference smaller than the partition sensitivity
cases.why: the partition term is part of U

cases.name: mean difference whose sign flips across 30 % of member pairs
cases.why: sign_consistency below s_min

cases.name: two single-geometry C18 records
cases.why: single geometries of flexible molecules

cases.name: a non-converged ensemble vs a converged one
cases.why: non-convergence travels with the comparison

cases.name: correspondence by atom index
cases.why: indices carry no chemistry (R5)

cases.name: a map pair whose atoms differ in element
cases.why: a map pair asserts homology

cases.name: SMARTS matching acetate's two equivalent oxygens
cases.why: symmetry-equivalent matches are one union site

cases.name: equal analysis_key, different espmap versions
cases.why: the key says comparable; the flag lets a reader check

cases.name: an ensemble vs a single record of the same flexible molecule
cases.worst: refused, or the single side treated as sampled
cases.why: mixed sources are allowed, flagged
